description: This file defines a React component named ViewCostDetailsModal, which renders a modal overlay displaying detailed cost information, including a summary view and raw JSON view. It manages state for user data, fetches user info asynchronously, and provides copy-to-clipboard functionality.

methods.name: ViewCostDetailsModal
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the cost details modal overlay.

methods.name: loadName
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch user name based on userId when modal opens or userId changes.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Utility callback to parse various numeric formats into a float number.

methods.name: fallbackCopy
methods.description: Function to copy text to clipboard using a fallback method if navigator.clipboard is unavailable.
